title: ResourceAllocationReport
description: The Resource Allocation agent's structured proposal. Validated by steps/resource_allocation_step.py against environment/allocation.py: validate_allocation_structure is a hard gate (assignments + rejected together must cover exactly the ranked task ids, each exactly once). check_constraints is a SEPARATE gate run only on structurally valid proposals -- a structurally valid assignment can still be environment-rejected for targeting a Maintenance machine or a saturated slice, independent of the agent's rationale.

machine_id.description: Must match a machine_id from the tool's available_machines.

network_slice_id.description: Must match a slice_id from the tool's available_slices.
